settings.title: Can we get images on the day?

settings.editor: Yes. Same-day selects are one of the most useful things we do at events — you can post while people are still in the room.

settings.title: How many photographers will be there?

settings.editor: [ accuracy read ] It depends on the size of the venue and how many things happen at once. A single-room conference is usually one; a multi-stream event needs two.
Yes, and there's a real advantage in it — by day two the crew knows the room, the run sheet and who the key people are.

settings.title: Can you film the speakers as well as photograph them?

settings.editor: Yes. Keynote capture and photography run together, and the talks become content long after the event.

settings.title: How soon do we get everything back?

settings.editor: [ accuracy read ] Selects within a few days, the full gallery and any highlights film inside two to three weeks.

settings.title: Will you get in the way?

settings.editor: No. Event work is done quietly with long lenses and available light wherever possible — most guests won't notice the crew at all.
